sections.heading: Opportunity Introduction
paragraphs: Nishiki Agricultural Processing Co., Ltd. is seeking qualified importers, distributors and private-label buyers in the United States and selected international markets for its range of Japanese konjac noodles and konjac-based prepared meals.

Introduced through Japan Industrial Promotion Inc. (JIP Japan), the opportunity covers both branded wholesale distribution and OEM / private-label manufacturing for health-food retailers and foodservice groups.

sections.heading: About Nishiki Agricultural Processing
paragraphs: Tracing its origins to 1905 and incorporated in 1983, Nishiki Agricultural Processing Co., Ltd. operates production facilities in Nishiki-machi, Iwakuni, Yamaguchi Prefecture, using local mountain spring water alongside its mineral water bottling plant.
The company maintains FSSC 22000 (certified 2013), ISO 22000 (2005), ISO 9001 and HACCP (2002) certifications, reflecting structured quality control for domestic retail and export.

sections.heading: Products and Commercial Strengths
paragraphs: The export-oriented lineup centers on wheat-free, gluten-free and low-calorie konjac products positioned on the company's official storefront: konjac somen and noodle formats engineered to minimize traditional konjac aroma and prepare quickly with a water rinse, as well as granular konjac risotto-style meals in flavors such as tomato and cheese.
With both branded SKUs and private-label capability, partners can address mainstream supermarkets, natural-food grocers and calorie-conscious meal-replacement channels.

sections.heading: International Expansion Opportunity
paragraphs: The United States is a primary target market given strong retail demand for gluten-free, plant-based and low-calorie noodle alternatives, alongside broader international health-food markets.
Partners can explore regional or national distribution, supermarket private-label programs, or foodservice supply.

sections.heading: Ideal Partner Profile
paragraphs: Ideal partners are US or international food importers, health-food and specialty grocery distributors, supermarket private-label buyers, and hospitality or wellness-oriented foodservice suppliers with established cold/ambient logistics and FDA/local import compliance experience.

sections.heading: Business Development Considerations
paragraphs: Food importers must verify US FDA facility registration, nutrition labeling compliance (including any gluten-free or calorie claims under local regulations), shelf-life requirements and customs classification. Pricing, MOQs and private-label specifications are provided after a qualified inquiry.

sections.heading: Why Explore This Opportunity
paragraphs: Combining a 1905 heritage in Yamaguchi konjac production with FSSC 22000 certification and ready-to-eat risotto and noodle formats gives importers a credible, audit-ready Japanese manufacturer for growing better-for-you food categories.

faqs.question: What products does Nishiki Agricultural Processing offer for export?
faqs.answer: Gluten-free, low-calorie konjac noodles (such as konjac somen), granular konjac risotto-style meals (including tomato and cheese varieties), and private-label / OEM konjac food products.

faqs.question: What food safety certifications does the manufacturer hold?
faqs.answer: According to its corporate profile, the company holds FSSC 22000, ISO 22000, ISO 9001 and HACCP certifications.

faqs.question: Are private-label or OEM projects possible?
faqs.answer: Yes. Private-label and OEM manufacturing inquiries are welcomed alongside branded distribution.

faqs.question: Which markets are targeted?
faqs.answer: The United States is a priority market, alongside additional international markets.

faqs.question: How are samples, MOQs and pricing arranged?
faqs.answer: Submit an inquiry through Partner Market Global; product specifications, MOQs and FOB/CIF terms are shared directly after partner qualification.
